readmeExcerpt:
Modern project management for all teams

Website • Forum • X • Documentation

Meet [Plane](https://plane.so/), an open-source project management tool to track issues, run ~sprints~ cycles, and manage product roadmaps without the chaos of managing the tool itself. 🧘‍♀️ > Plane is evolving every day. Your suggestions, ideas, and reported bugs help us immensely. Do not hesitate to join in the conversation on [Forum](https://forum.plane.so) or raise a GitHub issue. We read everything and respond to most. ## 🚀 Installation Getting started with Plane is simple. Choose the setup that works best for you: - **Plane Cloud** Sign up for a free account on [Plane Cloud](https://app.plane.so)—it's the fastest way to get up and running without worrying about infrastructure. - **Self-host Plane** Prefer full control over your data and infrastructure? Install and run Plane on your own servers. Follow our detailed [deployment guides](https://developers.plane.so/self-hosting/overview) to get started. | Installation methods | Docs link | | -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Docker | | | Kubernetes | | | All-in-one Docker | [deployments/aio/community](./deployments/aio/community/README.md) · [docs](https://developers.plane.so/self-hosting/methods/docker-aio) | `Instance admins` can configure instance settings with [God mode](https://developers.plane.so/self-hosting/govern/instance-admin). ## 🌟 Features - **Work Items** Efficiently create and manage tasks with a robust rich text editor that supports file uploads. Enhance organization and tracking by adding sub-properties and referencing related issues. - **Cycles** Maintain your team’s momentum with Cycles. Track progress effortlessly using burn-down charts and other insightful tools. - **Modules** Simplify complex projects by dividing them into smaller, manageable modules. - **Views** Customize your workflow by creating filters to display only the most relevant issues. Save and share these views with ease. - **Pages** Capture and organize ideas using Plane Pages, complete with AI capabilities and a rich text editor. Format text, insert images, add hyperlinks, or convert your notes into actionable items. - **Analytics** Access real-time insights across all your Plane data. Visualize trends, remove blockers, and keep your projects moving forward. ## 🛠️ Local development See [CONTRIBUTING](./CONTRIBUTING.md) ## ⚙️ Built with ## 📸 Screenshots

## 📝 Documentation Explore Plane's [product documentation](https://docs.plane.so/) and [developer documentation](https://developers.plane.so/) to learn about features, setup, and usage. ## ❤️ Community Join the Plane community on our [Forum](https://forum.plane.so), and use [GitHub issues](https://github.com/makeplane/plane/issues) for bug reports and feature requests. We follow a [Code of conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) in all our community channels. Feel free to ask questions, report bugs, participate in discussions, share ideas, request features, or showcase your projects. We’d love to hear from you! ## 🛡️ Security If you discover a security vulnerability in Plane, please report it responsibly instead of opening a public issue. We take all legitimate reports seriously and will investigate them promptly. See [Security policy](./SECURITY.md) for more info. To disclose any security issues, please [report them privately on GitHub](https://github.com/makeplane/plane/security/advisories/new) or email us at security@plane.so. ## 🤝 Contributing There are many ways you can contribute to Plane: - Report [bugs](https://github.com/makeplane/plane/issues/new?template=--bug-report.yaml) or submit [feature requests](https://github.com/makeplane/plane/issues/new?template=--feature-request.yaml). - Review the [documentation](https://docs.plane.so/) and tell us on the [Forum](https://forum.plane.so) or in a GitHub issue where it is wrong or incomplete. - Add or update [translations](./CONTRIBUTING.md#contributing-to-language-support). - Talk or write about Plane or any other ecosystem integration and [let us know](https://forum.plane.so)! - Show your support by upvoting [popular feature requests](https://github.com/makeplane/plane/issues). Please read [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for details on the process for submitting pull requests to us. ### Repo activity ### We couldn't have done this without you. ## License This project is licensed under the [GNU Affero General Public License v3.0](./LICENSE.txt).

Modern project management for all teams

Website • Forum • X • Documentation

Meet Plane, an open-source project management tool to track issues, run sprints cycles, and manage product roadmaps without the chaos of managing the tool itself. 🧘‍♀️

Plane is evolving every day. Your suggestions, ideas, and reported bugs help us immensely. Do not hesitate to join in the conversation on Forum or raise a GitHub issue. We read everything and respond to most.

🚀 Installation

Getting started with Plane is simple. Choose the setup that works best for you:

  • Plane Cloud Sign up for a free account on Plane Cloud—it's the fastest way to get up and running without worrying about infrastructure.

  • Self-host Plane Prefer full control over your data and infrastructure? Install and run Plane on your own servers. Follow our detailed deployment guides to get started.

Installation methods Docs link
Docker
Kubernetes
All-in-one Docker deployments/aio/community · docs

Instance admins can configure instance settings with God mode.

🌟 Features

  • Work Items Efficiently create and manage tasks with a robust rich text editor that supports file uploads. Enhance organization and tracking by adding sub-properties and referencing related issues.

  • Cycles Maintain your team’s momentum with Cycles. Track progress effortlessly using burn-down charts and other insightful tools.

  • Modules Simplify complex projects by dividing them into smaller, manageable modules.

  • Views Customize your workflow by creating filters to display only the most relevant issues. Save and share these views with ease.

  • Pages Capture and organize ideas using Plane Pages, complete with AI capabilities and a rich text editor. Format text, insert images, add hyperlinks, or convert your notes into actionable items.

  • Analytics Access real-time insights across all your Plane data. Visualize trends, remove blockers, and keep your projects moving forward.

🛠️ Local development

See CONTRIBUTING

⚙️ Built with

📸 Screenshots

📝 Documentation

Explore Plane's product documentation and developer documentation to learn about features, setup, and usage.

❤️ Community

Join the Plane community on our Forum, and use GitHub issues for bug reports and feature requests. We follow a Code of conduct in all our community channels.

Feel free to ask questions, report bugs, participate in discussions, share ideas, request features, or showcase your projects. We’d love to hear from you!

🛡️ Security

If you discover a security vulnerability in Plane, please report it responsibly instead of opening a public issue. We take all legitimate reports seriously and will investigate them promptly. See Security policy for more info.

To disclose any security issues, please report them privately on GitHub or email us at security@plane.so.

🤝 Contributing

There are many ways you can contribute to Plane:

  • Report bugs or submit feature requests.
  • Review the documentation and tell us on the Forum or in a GitHub issue where it is wrong or incomplete.
  • Add or update translations.
  • Talk or write about Plane or any other ecosystem integration and let us know!
  • Show your support by upvoting popular feature requests.

Please read CONTRIBUTING.md for details on the process for submitting pull requests to us.

Repo activity

We couldn't have done this without you.

releases.name: v1.4.3
releases.body:
### 🐞  Bug fixes

- Fixed voting on published work items that had no votes yet, which previously failed without registering the vote.
- Fixed archiving a cycle that has no end date.
- Fixed work item links being re-crawled on every update even when the URL had not changed.
- The REST API now returns a validation error when a work item is created or updated with assignees or labels that do not belong to the project, instead of silently dropping them.
- Fixed MinIO image pulls failing after the `minio` organization was removed from Docker Hub. Bundled object storage now uses the `pgsty/silo` image, pinned to a release tag instead of `latest`.
- Fixed `install.sh` and `swarm.sh` failing to find the latest release now that the GitHub API returns compact JSON. Both scripts now stop with an error when the lookup fails instead of continuing with an empty version.
- Hardened the airgapped restore script: it now maps backup folders to the volume paths the airgapped compose file expects, cleans stale extracted data before restoring, and rolls back to the old data if a directory swap fails or is interrupted.

### 🛡️ Security

aiSummary.oneLiner: An open-source project management tool for tracking issues, sprints, and product roadmaps.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Plane is a modern, open-source project management platform designed to track issues, run iterative cycles, and manage comprehensive product roadmaps. It offers a clean interface and provides essential features like robust issue tracking, custom states, and varied operational views including list, kanban, and calendar layouts. It aims to offer the power of enterprise agile tools without the associated complexity or cost, allowing teams to self-host and maintain strict control over their project data. The underlying architecture supports deep customization to perfectly match any team's unique workflows and reporting needs.
keyFeatures: Issue tracking engine: Manages tasks, bugs, and enhancement requests effectively within a centralized, modern interface.
Sprint management: Supports running iterative cycles and managing agile sprints directly within the tool.
Multiple visualization views: Allows users to switch seamlessly between list, kanban board, and calendar views for their data.
Customizable states: Enables teams to easily define their own workflow stages to match specific organizational processes.
Self-hosting capabilities: Allows organizations to deploy the software entirely on their own infrastructure for complete data privacy.

useCases.title: Agile project management
useCases.description: Software development teams running sprints who need a modern, open-source alternative to proprietary tools like Jira or Linear.

useCases.title: Product roadmap planning
useCases.description: Product managers requiring a centralized platform to plan, visualize, and track long-term product roadmaps effectively.

useCases.title: Data-sensitive operations
useCases.description: Enterprises that strictly mandate data sovereignty and require self-hosted project management infrastructure.

useCases.title: Custom workflow implementation
useCases.description: Organizations with highly unique operational processes that need flexible custom states and sophisticated issue routing.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Product teams, project managers, and software developers seeking an open-source, highly customizable project management solution. Self-hosting the platform requires experience with Docker and basic infrastructure management.
